fields.value: Measurement Data for Experimental Modeling of Synthetic Fiber Ropes for Slip Compensation for Application in Cable

value: Messdaten für Experimentelle Modellbildung synthetischer Faserseile zur Schlupfkompensation für die Anwendung in Seilrobotern

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset contains the raw measurement data recorded from the experiments.

All measurements data is provided in the folder "Data" in form of CSV files which can be analyzed and processed with the Analysis Toolbox in https://doi.org/10.18419/DARUS-5172. The raw data ist stored in a TwinCAT Scope file SVDX. Additionally, the motion profile is stored as NC file. The data is structured according to the directory names: "WC" stands for applied cable forces and "DP" for the applied drum preload. Each single CSV file consists a times series data. The software of the control system can be found in https://doi.org/10.18419/DARUS-5170

Settings of the linear measuring sensors Polytec LSV-2100 and the control system can be found in the "Settings" folder.

publicationCitation.value: Reichenbach, Thomas: Experimentelle Modellbildung synthetischer Faserseile zur Schlupfkompensation für die Anwendung in Seilrobotern. Stuttgart : Fraunhofer Verlag, 2026. Dissertation Universität Stuttgart. ISBN 978-3-8396-2198-1.
